title: Quiet Friday close
status: agent-authored extension: a versioned composition of existing definitions; no new operator and no grammar change
meaning: True at anchor t iff (1) the New York date of t is a Friday nyse_regular session, (2) t lies in that session's tail (close - last, close], and (3) quiet_range(window: 4h, width_max) was true at every 15m sample from t - quiet_for through t. The three parts combine with strong Kleene AND: one known false disproves it; otherwise any unknown part makes it unknown. With its defaults it is the starter question's three where clauses at last: 1h.

params.name: last
params.doc: tail length before the nyse_regular close (at most the shortest session)

params.name: width_max
params.doc: quiet range limit: (highest high - lowest low) over 4h / close; the default equals "Quiet range" v1

body: weekday(nyse_regular) = fri and session_tail(nyse_regular, last: last) and held(quiet_range(window: 4h, width_max: width_max), for: quiet_for)
label: quiet Friday close (last {last} of a Friday nyse_regular session; 4h width ≤ {width_max} held {quiet_for})
availability: Uses only the anchor timestamp, the pinned calendar and bars that closed at or before t.
missing: Outside calendar coverage, or in the quiet warmup with no known false, it is unknown. Known closed dates are false.
replay: Version 1 replays from the pinned component versions and the calendar table above. Changing any component, default or this body requires quiet_friday_close@2; version 1 stays unchanged.
